exposure: Risk of ophthalmological complications during delivery (low, medium, high)
outcome: Risk of ophthalmological complications during delivery
cohort: 69 pregnant women affected with retinal degenerative lesions.
finding: Ophthalmological assessment in pregnant women with retinal disorders is crucial to stratify risk and guide delivery decisions, as higher risk correlated with higher rates of cesarean section.
mod_finding: In the high-risk group for ophthalmological complications, the rate of cesarean section was 87%, while in both the low- and medium-risk groups the rate of vaginal births was 75%.
